headline: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops AI rankings; UK funds a rogue-agent unit
body: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, which it says tops the Artificial Analysis index and leads on finding software vulnerabilities, releasing it first to cyber defenders; with a report that OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPUs, Capability Velocity rose 0.25. The UK Budget funded a unit to respond to rogue AI agents, Anthropic told California's governor courts should be able to block risky models, and India weighed a frontier-model safety regime (Alignment & Control +0.15). New York banned AI companions from posing as humans to minors and parents sued OpenAI over ChatGPT medication advice (Tech Backlash +0.13). Malaysia seized $12 million of smuggled AI chips (Global Coordination +0.08). Gatekeeper, Protector God and Enslaved God rose. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -10.09 from -10.25.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.2, mostly from Gemini 4 Carbon (+0.11) and Malaysia's chip seizure (+0.05), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05). Enslaved God +0.2, mostly from Gemini 4 Carbon (+0.17) and OpenAI's TPU plan (+0.06), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). Protector God +0.2, mostly from Gemini 4 Carbon (+0.14) and OpenAI's TPU plan (+0.05), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.08).
coming_up: New York's AI companion law takes effect on 1 January 2027
